[{"role": "assistant", "content": "Here are USGS publications with "National Water Summary" in the title:

1. **National water summary on wetland resources** (Water Supply Paper 2425, 1996)
   - Overview of wetland resources in the U.S., including state-by-state descriptions.
   - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wsp/2425/report.pdf)
   - [NGMDB Index Page](https://ngmdb.usgs.gov/Prodesc/proddesc_25395.htm)

2. **Supplemental reference list for the National Water Summary on Wetland Resources** (Open-File Report 96-169, 1996) — by K. Fry
   - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/of/1996/0169/report.pdf)

3. **National water summary 1990-91: Hydrologic events and stream water quality** (Water Supply Paper 2400, 1993)
   - Documents stream water quality in the U.S. and Puerto Rico; provides congressional reporting context.
   - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wsp/2400/report.pdf)
   - [NGMDB Index Page](https://ngmdb.usgs.gov/Prodesc/proddesc_25394.htm)

4. **Hydrologic data-collection stations whose stream water quality data were available to prepare the 1990-91 National Water Summary on Stream Water Quality** (Open-File Report 93-29, 1993) — by K.J. Lanfear
   - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/of/1993/0029/report.pdf)

5. **National water summary 1988–89: Hydrologic events and floods and droughts** (Water Supply Paper 2375, 1991)
   - Examines floods and droughts, including their extent and frequency across states.
   - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wsp/2375/report.pdf)
   - [NGMDB Index Page](https://ngmdb.usgs.gov/Prodesc/proddesc_25393.htm)

6. **National water summary 1987: Hydrologic events and water supply and use** (Water Supply Paper 2350, 1990)
   - Focuses on water use in the U.S. as of 1985, includes state-by-state information.
   - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wsp/2350/report.pdf)
   - [NGMDB Index Page](https://ngmdb.usgs.gov/Prodesc/proddesc_25392.htm)

7. **Methodology to derive water-quality trends for use by the National Water Summary Program of the U.S. Geological Survey** (Open-File Report 90-359, 1990) — by K.J. Lanfear & R. Alexander
   - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/of/1990/0359/report.pdf)

8. **National water summary 1986: Hydrologic events and ground-water quality** (Water Supply Paper 2325, 1988)
   - Covers ground-water quality, contamination sources, and protection issues.
   - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wsp/2325/report.pdf)
   - [NGMDB Index Page](https://ngmdb.usgs.gov/Prodesc/proddesc_25391.htm)

9. **National Water Summary Program** (Open-File Report 88-713, 1988) — by Edith Chase
   - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/of/1988/0713/report.pdf)

10. **National water summary 1985: Hydrologic events and surface-water resources** (Water Supply Paper 2300, 1986)
    - Focus on surface-water resource development and management.
    - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wsp/2300/report.pdf)
    - [NGMDB Index Page](https://ngmdb.usgs.gov/Prodesc/proddesc_25390.htm)

11. **National water summary 1984: Hydrologic events, selected water-quality trends, and ground-water resources** (Water Supply Paper 2275, 1985)
    - Reviews hydrologic extremes and trends in water quality.
    - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wsp/2275/report.pdf)
    - [NGMDB Index Page](https://ngmdb.usgs.gov/Prodesc/proddesc_25396.htm)

12. **National water summary 1983: Hydrologic events and issues** (Water Supply Paper 2250, 1984)
    - Documents hydrologic events and water quality issues in the U.S.
    - [Full Report PDF](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wsp/2250/report.pdf)

These documents serve as national compendia of water events, quality, usage, and issues by year or topic. If you need details or help narrowing to a specific year or theme, let me know!"}]
